forbidden_changes: PR26 strategy, July evidence, protocols and current branch
research/holdout sources, financial rules, universe and freeze record
native PSSM, DTSS or DTSSR activation
live connector configuration, credentials, orders and transfers

prior_research.pr26_disposition: CLOSED_WITHOUT_MERGE: preserve the research head and evidence; the separately frozen holdout and fresh-cash follow-up continue.
prior_research.economic_verdict: All four tested capital-quality redeployment arms failed to beat unchanged PARK under the predeclared account-equity, drawdown and terminal-open-loss criteria. Retain PARK; do not retune or promote rejected policies.

prospective_holdout.fresh_cash_adapter: OUTSTANDING_SEPARATE_WORK: implement and independently audit against frozen five-arm fresh-$2000 rules before November scoring; do not use prospective prices or hedge findings to change those rules.

stage_order.name: Evidence, capability, data and ownership audit
deliverables: Reconcile PR26 saved July account/lot/cash evidence and preserve its negative verdict.
Audit current official Kraken routes, account eligibility, API availability, instrument terms and collateral/legal recourse.
Inventory historical tapes, point-in-time listing identities, fills, cash/lot histories, historical derivative specs and funding.
Produce missing-input and uncertainty register; propose complete immutable H1 manifest without reading sealed holdout prices.
Create per-asset inventory and concentration schemas without inventing missing records.

stage_order.name: Bounded BTC benchmark hedge against matched PARK
stage_order.admission: Complete machine-checkable manifest, independent preflight and source/input freeze before any run.
stage_order.spot_policy: Unchanged PARK trace; identical spot fills, lots, marks and source decisions in all arms. Overlay does not feed hedge P&L or consolidated equity back into spot decisions.

stage_order.name: BTC plus ETH benchmark hedge
stage_order.admission: Separate protocol and manifest only after H1 is fully reported and a useful bounded hedge is supported; predeclare weights and estimators before its outcomes.

stage_order.name: BTC plus ETH plus SOL benchmark hedge
stage_order.admission: Separate protocol only after earlier benchmark coverage and rebound results justify broader exposure.

stage_order.name: Matched assets, dynamic baskets, closed-loop spot budgets and hedge-profit accumulation
stage_order.admission: Each is a separately frozen experiment. No same-matrix causal mixing or production permission is implied.

experiment_classes.historical_realistic: Actual event dates, then-available spot listings, then-eligible derivative/margin contracts, terms, collateral recourse, costs and restrictions. Missing history prevents a historical-realistic account-performance claim.
experiment_classes.current_system_crash_shape: Current verified eligible instruments/specifications applied to explicitly transformed historical crash-shaped paths. Label synthetic path/basis assumptions and do not describe this as historically executable.
experiment_classes.unfunded_or_incomplete_scenario: Illustrative scenario only if finite cash/margin, legal recourse or executable route cannot be reproduced; never total-account performance or evidence for deployment.

spot_ownership_contract.active_slot_rule: Retain pinned PARK/native limits and user breadth doctrine; no production slot-rule changes.
spot_ownership_contract.unknown_units_basis_or_mark: Explicit UNKNOWN or UNPRICED_OWNED with valuation sensitivity; never fabricated zero.
spot_ownership_contract.conversions: Record actual verified conversion events, units, timestamps and successor identity; preserve lot provenance.

books_and_capital.collateral_recourse_required: Verified route-specific eligibility, segregation, cross-collateral assets, closeout rights and liquidation waterfall. Spot-margin cash collateral alone cannot prove owned spot inventory is protected from venue liquidation.
books_and_capital.starting_capital_rule: Every arm begins with the exact same consolidated equity E0, spot units/basis and cash ownership. No additional money is injected into a hedge arm alone.
books_and_capital.default_allowed_source: Explicitly authorized and verified unencumbered ordinary cash only; absent spendable ordinary cash blocks this design. No implicit VCAP/PARK transfer.
books_and_capital.matched_budget_rule: Before each matrix, declare B within E0, preserve original ownership and reserve equivalent B outside SPOT decision authority in every arm. PARK_OFF holds B as cash; hedge arms split the same B into free cash, locked margin and paid costs. Fees and losses debit finite available balances exactly once.
books_and_capital.additional_capital_conditional_experimen: If B cannot exist within E0 and extra research capital is proposed, every arm must receive the same extra B; report initial equity as E0+B and label a distinct conditional experiment. This is not the original unmodified starting-account result.
books_and_capital.unmodified_trace_feasibility: Verify unchanged PARK spot/cash decisions remain feasible after the common B carve-out. If not, BLOCK overlay; propose a separately frozen native budget-allocation replay rather than subtracting cash retrospectively.
books_and_capital.transfers: Explicit paired debit/credit events with original ownership, timestamp and reason; internal transfer is neither account profit nor external flow.
cash_and_units_invariants: Free cash, locked collateral, pending claims and all source owners reconcile without double counting.
No negative spendable source cash, no borrowing from VCAP/PARK and no unapproved collateral pledge.
No hedge notional beyond its funded route-specific admission, limits and economic hedge cap.
Lot-unit and disposal/basis conservation holds at every event.
Collateral liquidation, if modeled, reduces the actual seized book assets and records costs, never just the hedge book.

causal_hedge_model.estimator: Rolling portfolio-to-BTC beta calculated from completed, timestamp-aligned historical observations strictly available before decision time; no full-window fit or future membership.
causal_hedge_model.target_formula: target_notional = min(ratio * max(0, causal_beta) * verified_marked_spot_exposure, verified_marked_spot_exposure, funded_route_risk_cap). Round down to contract increment; minimum violations mean no order.
causal_hedge_model.economic_notional_cap: BTC short notional must not exceed verified marked spot long exposure; hedge is protection, not net-short speculation. Contract leverage/margin limits still require explicit frozen values.
causal_hedge_model.unknown_exposure_or_beta: Deny new/increased hedge; apply separately frozen risk-reduction policy to existing exposure. Missingness never becomes a proven zero.

triggers.hysteresis_requirement: Different entry/exit conditions and deterministic transition precedence must be encoded before outcomes. No signal shopping or threshold retuning within this matrix.

causal_hedge_model.decision_execution_order: Closed-data observation -> state transition -> bounded target -> route/cash admission -> submission -> latency -> eligible future execution event -> book/account updates. Same timestamp ordering across arms must be frozen.

inventory_and_portfolio_reports.quality_admission: Point-in-time fields only, with publication/availability timestamps and missingness; future survival/recovery cannot enter original admission or trigger features.
inventory_and_portfolio_reports.concentration_denominator: Report spot-owned-value weights and consolidated-account-equity weights separately; disclose cash and unpriced ownership rather than silently renormalizing it away.
inventory_and_portfolio_reports.effective_holding_count_definition: Use 1/sum(w_i^2) for explicitly normalized known-valued spot holding weights summing to one. Disclose excluded unpriced ownership and cash separately. Do not describe a reciprocal of non-normalized consolidated-equity weights as an effective number of holdings.
inventory_and_portfolio_reports.future_evaluation_start: Verified crash/test terminal timestamp; exact checkpoint and observation-tolerance rules must be in the manifest.
inventory_and_portfolio_reports.censoring: Not yet elapsed, unavailable history, listing exit and unknown pricing are distinct. Record observed-as-of cutoff; never count an unobserved checkpoint as failure, recovery or zero.
inventory_and_portfolio_reports.tail_caps: Research proposal only; no production cap or residual deletion is introduced.

accounting_and_outcomes.equity_identity: E_end-E_start = external_deposits-external_withdrawals + net_realized_spot_pnl + net_realized_hedge_pnl + change_in_unrealized_spot_pnl + change_in_unrealized_hedge_pnl + other_verified_income_expense. Fees/funding/borrow/rollover/liquidation costs are included exactly once under the declared net/gross convention.

mechanical_required: finite funded account and margin path
no unapproved collateral seizure or recourse
no fabricated fills or missing marks
economic_candidate_required: strictly lower maximum consolidated drawdown than matched PARK
strictly higher terminal consolidated equity after all costs than matched PARK
available cash and margin remain within predeclared limits
criteria hold under all declared adverse execution/cost/mark sensitivities
success_predeclaration.mixed_result_label: Trade-off only: preserve drawdown, equity, collateral cost and rebound effects separately; no successful-candidate claim when required criteria fail.
success_predeclaration.statistics: Paired deterministic path differences are descriptive. All ratios/regimes and missingness reported; no universal profitability, statistical significance or generalization claim from a reused historical path. Any inferential procedure needs independent, predeclared sampling and uncertainty rules.

abort_rules: Any source/hash mismatch, production or holdout mutation, future-data leakage or incomplete required manifest field.
Any ownership, units, basis, cash, cost or equity conservation failure.
Any unmodeled collateral recourse, unavailable instrument, missing decisive execution data or inability to reproduce finite margin funding.
Predeclared per-arm compute budget exceeded: preserve incomplete evidence and do not compare it as a completed arm.
accounting_and_outcomes.economic_stress_rule: Within a valid frozen model, no-fill, margin call, liquidation, outage and suspension outcomes are retained as adverse economic outcomes, not discarded paths. Modeling omissions instead invalidate performance claims.

machine_rules: No null, UNKNOWN, TBD, BLOCKED or implicit default in any required section; not-applicable must be justified for the exact route.
All source, input and official evidence hashes exist and match; all referenced required paths are readable.

Declared required market inputs must be typed market_data and provide pre-embargo coverage. Reject sealed paths and prospective market coverage before reading artifacts. The manifest declarations are not independently trusted provenance.
Exactly the five H1 arms and fixed ratios; same spot trace and same explicit E0/cash-source allocation across arms.

Require explicit route/account/API and collateral/legal-recourse declarations bound to hashed evidence. Independent semantic evidence review must establish those facts; validator acceptance alone cannot do so.
Every missing numeric parameter in this design is resolved and independently reviewed before running.
Freeze all parameters, budgets, cost perturbations and result rules before any strategy outcome; later amendments receive new campaign/run identity and retain rejected evidence.
run_manifest_gate.decision: Preparation only. Validator acceptance checks declarations and local hashes; it neither executes strategies nor independently proves causal data, account eligibility, cash/trace feasibility or venue isolation. Independent semantic evidence review and a complete immutable run manifest are separately required before any strategy run.

eta.initial_assessment_estimate: 60-90 minutes for evidence/capability/data availability and prerequisites, excluding external-access delays.
eta.simulation_estimate: BLOCKED: give Architect a rough ETA before a new run after exact dataset size, eligible route, completed manifest and measured native adapter runtime are known.
